Show the project commands act on here and why, who you are signed in as, and the health of the
project's setup: the stores it is connected to, products mapped to store products, purchases waiting
for a product, events from the SDKs, and webhooks. Each part that needs something names the command
that fixes it, and the last line is what to do next.

A part your credential cannot read shows as "could not check"; the rest is still reported.

Usage:
  voidhash status [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash status
  voidhash status --project acme/app --json
